title: Package, install, desktop shortcut, final captures, handoff and archive
acceptance: the release viewer is installed from the built installer, the desktop shortcut points at the new binary, `cargo xtask verify`, `cargo deny check` and `cargo xtask goal-verify --all` outputs are pasted, final captures exist in all four theme/control combinations, and the handoff and archived plan are in the repo
notes: Release close-out. Build the release viewer, run scripts/package.ps1 -Installer, install it, and confirm the desktop shortcut target is the newly built binary (path and target recorded). Capture the installed build in light and dark, each with native and Windows control styles, with the default Documents\PDFXI library folder. Paste the output of `cargo xtask verify`, `cargo deny check` (currently red on RUSTSEC-2026-0543, see orchestration/blockers/chrono-unmaintained.md) and `cargo xtask goal-verify --all`. Tick every A-/O- row in docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md only after the orchestrator's own installed-build check. Write the handoff under orchestration/handoff/ and archive the plan under the in-repo archive path (docs/plans/archive/**); do not touch ~/.opencode/plan or any global config from this task record. Audit every reachable app string for placeholder, demo or roadmap copy before captures: `--demo-comments`/`--demo-popup` are being removed under T-0242, `side_panel.rs` placeholder panels under T-0246, and `ui.rs` `canvas_placeholder` must not claim a shipped capability is unavailable. Grep for 'placeholder', 'arrives', 'round B', 'not available', 'coming soon', 'demo' in `crates/pdfxi-app/src/**` and record the clean result in the handoff. Re-run `cargo deny check` at final packaging; if the chrono advisory reappears through pdfium-render, record a scoped decision rather than leaving the gate red. O-02 final check: the orchestrator prints a real fixture to the Brother printer (not only Microsoft Print to PDF) and records the physical result; if the printer is unavailable, record that blocker rather than ticking O-02. Final copy audit: `crates/pdfxi-app/src/ui.rs::canvas_placeholder` says 'page rendering is not available in this shell yet'; in the installed build it must be a neutral loading/empty message or absent. Check that the `{feature} is not available in this build` status at `ui.rs` is unreachable for every shipped capability. Check `capabilities.rs` comments ('Today's build') and the enabled set match the shipped tools; unsupported entries must be absent, not disabled-with-copy.
